body:
Independent native review of proposed #2451 b035: opening an administrator-selected FIFO while holding the existing rotating-handler lock delays a background logger until a reader opens the FIFO. The prior version let that logger proceed within one second; the settings request itself could block in either version. A hung administrator-selected filesystem is the related source-level concern, not a measured deployed failure.

The lock preserves the repaired concurrent rotation/replacement identity seam. Narrowing it requires revalidation against the active handler/inode after opening; constructing a replacement before locking without that revalidation restores the independently reproduced duplicate-record race. Separate source/native/installed logging corrections are qualified clear. Investigate bounded target-open behavior without weakening their rotation, fallback or reload guarantees. No whole installed stalled-filesystem or arbitrary FIFO guarantee is made.
title: Logging reload can hold active writers while opening a stalled administrator-selected target
